description: Canonical normal forms on \(n\) inputs have at most \(2^n\) terms or clauses, each containing exactly \(n\) literals.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonical_normal_form_lengths.{u} {α : Type u} {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → α)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.TruthFunction n) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalDnf p f).length ≤ 2 ^ n ∧
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalCnf p f).length ≤ 2 ^ n ∧
      (∀ l ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalDnf p f, l.length = n) ∧
        ∀ l ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalCnf p f, l.length = n
